transcript: Hello, and thank you for calling the information line for the lifeguard division for the city of Oceanside. Please choose from the following options for our weather and surf report. Please press 1. Good morning. The following Oceanside surf report was recorded on Tuesday, November 17 at 08:15AM. Under some partially cloudy skies, we got a three to five foot west swell with poor shape. Water temperature is 73 degrees with five mile per hour wind blowing on the North Northeast. Today's ties include a low of 3.0 at 09:32 this morning, rising to a high of 3.8 at 02:29 this afternoon. If you like any further information on the Oceanside Lifeguard service, the tides of surf as well, please dial (760) 435-4018. Thank you. Have a safe... Have a great day. No one is available to take your call. Thank you for calling. Goodbye.
